notes: Official Evolution documentation lists 50x, 100x, 200x, 300x, 400x and 500x for standard Lightning Roulette.
A value such as 150x must not be silently rejected if observed in a real round; it is retained as an anomaly and investigated for variant, promotion, UI transformation or source error.
XXXtreme Lightning Roulette uses the same 50x-500x base Lightning multipliers, while Chain Lightning/Double Strike mechanics can increase outcomes up to 2000x.
trainingRule: Only round-level observations with timestamp, winning number, full Lucky Number set and multiplier mapping enter the scientific corpus.
